entries.title: Job 35:2
segments: Does it seem to you to be right, and righteousness before God, to say,

entries.title: Job 35:3
segments: What profit is it to me, and how am I better off than if I had done wrong?

entries.title: Job 35:4
segments: I will make answer to you and to your friends:

entries.title: Job 35:5
segments: Let your eyes be turned to the heavens, and lifted up to see the skies; they are higher than you.

entries.title: Job 35:6
segments: If you have done wrong, is he any the worse for it? and if your sins are great in number, what is it to him?

entries.title: Job 35:7
segments: If you are upright, what do you give to him? or what does he take from your hand?

entries.title: Job 35:8
segments: Your evil-doing may have an effect on a man like yourself, or your righteousness on a son of man.

entries.title: Job 35:9
segments: ¶Because the hand of the cruel is hard on them, men are making sounds of grief; they are crying out for help because of the arm of the strong.

entries.title: Job 35:10
segments: But no one has said, Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night;

entries.title: Job 35:11
segments: Who gives us more knowledge than the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heaven?

entries.title: Job 35:12
segments: There they are crying out because of the pride of the evil-doers, but he gives them no answer.

entries.title: Job 35:13
segments: But God will not give ear to what is false, or the Ruler of all take note of it;

entries.title: Job 35:14
segments: ¶How much less when you say that you do not see him; that the cause is before him, and you are waiting for him.

entries.title: Job 35:16
segments: And Job's mouth is open wide to give out what is of no profit, increasing words without knowledge.
